kebab_example: aliyun btripopen invoice-modify --third-part-id 340049 --type 1 --title '测试发票' --tax-no 122333121 --unit-type 1 --bank-name 12345678 --bank-no 2222 --address '注册地址' --tel 12345678 --mail-third-part-id example-string --x-acs-btrip-so-corp-token feth00jqwls --api-version 2022-05-20 --region cn-hangzhou
name: InvoiceModify

parameters.help_en:
The invoice type. Valid values:

1: VAT general invoice.
2: VAT special invoice
parameters.help_zh: 类型，1:增值税普通发票,2:增值税专用发票
parameters.name: type

parameters.help_en: The tax identification number. This parameter is required when unit_type is set to 1 and optional when unit_type is set to 2
parameters.help_zh: 税号，当unit_type=1时税号必填，unit_type=2时非必填
parameters.name: tax_no

parameters.help_en:
The entity type. Valid values:

1: enterprise (tax number required).
2: non-enterprise (tax number optional).

Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh: 单位性质：1-企业单位（税号必填），2-非企业单位（税号非必填）。默认为企业单位
parameters.name: unit_type

parameters.help_en: The name of the bank where the account is opened
parameters.name: bank_name

parameters.help_en: The third-party ID of the mailing address
parameters.name: mail_third_part_id

parameters.help_en: A header parameter obtained from the enterprise access credential operation. Add this parameter to the request header. In HTTP mode, you can use so_corp_token=value or dtb_corp_token=value in the URL as an alternative
parameters.help_zh: header参数 由“企业访问凭证”接口获取（添加在header里）,http模式可以在链接中使用so_corp_token=value或者dtb_corp_token=value来替代
parameters.name: x_acs_btrip_so_corp_token
